resources.string: Choose or reset a bandwidth limit. Using a limit switches Streaming Quality to Custom.
Replay a short part before the saved position when resuming a video. None resumes at the saved position.
Skipping requires segment information supplied by your Jellyfin server for the video. These choices do not detect intros, recaps or credits themselves.
Play through this segment without a skip prompt or automatic skip.
Automatically jump to the end when playback reaches a supported segment.
Show a skip prompt when playback reaches a supported segment. Keep watching unless you choose to skip.
